messages:
maria: Kicking off micro codelabs seed sequence — goal: 6 x 1hr codelabs + 3 short demos over 6 weeks. Need owners: copy, lab author, video, checklist. @aj you good to lead?

aj: Yep. I can own lab authoring workflow and the repo. Will spin up a repo template under /micro-codelabs. Need a checklist for marketing assets.

sam: I can do webinar blurb and host the first live lab. Timeline ok? We should pair a live lab within 2 weeks of first published lab.

kevin: I'll add infra example + small deploy script for Redwood Private. Quick snippet we can reuse:

```bash
git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/micro-codelabs.git
make setup
./deploy --model gptq-3b --quantize=true
```

aj: Also adding a CI check: ensure README has steps, quickstart, and eval snippets. I'll PR the template.

maria: Marketing asks: short launch post, 3 tweets, 1 blog, + demo video. Draft tweet copy pinned here:

- tweet 1: New micro-codelab live: build an embeddings search assistant with Redwood Optimize — step-by-step + repo
- tweet 2: Live workshop + demo this Thu — RSVP: https://example.com/rsvp
- tweet 3: Want private deployment examples? We shipped a one-click infra sample.

aj: Routing inbound leads: we want a form capturing company size + use case + infra preference. Send to /webhooks/marketing?source=codelab

sam: Add checkbox for 'interested in dedicated/private' — triggers SDR routing. @kevin can you confirm webhook payload?

kevin: Yes. Payload: company, email, size, use_case, infra_pref, codelab_id. We will add tags: webinar-registrant, inquiry-codelab

maria: :rocket: timeline proposal: Week1 publish lab 1 + tweet thread; Week2 live lab 1; Week3 lab2 + demo; Week4 lab3 + webinar; Week5 lab4; Week6 wrap + long-form blog. Thoughts?

aj: OK. I'll create Trello, assign owners, and open PRs for template. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/micro-codelabs/pull/2

sam: :thumbsup: I'll draft webinar slides. Can we get 30 RSVPs baseline? If yes, we push to paid partners.

maria: Great. I'll write the short launch post and iterate copy in doc: https://docs.google.com/seed-codelabs-copy (will ping for review).

aj: :eyes: assigning tasks now. If anyone wants to coauthor labs, drop your name. Closing loop: owners = maria (marketing), aj (content+repo), sam (webinar), kevin (infra).
